subject: A newsletter source for Warmly MCP
body:
Newsletter coverage is a signal family the MCP does not carry, and it is the one that says which publications wrote about an account, who sponsors them, and whether those lists are rising.

NewsletterFIT derives those records from the newsletter ecosystem with AI: publication, article, sponsors, brands, people, topics, mentions and momentum, each with source URL and date, shaped as company, domain, publication, date and sponsor so it drops into the stream you already normalise.

Warmly appears in 4 articles in our graph, Clay in 92 across 56 publications. The signal exists at volume in this category.

If the ninth family is worth a look, I can send a sample mapped to the field names yours already use.
